project.title: Ride Slowly, Ride Safely
project.logline: Two siblings learn that safe cycling matters more than winning a race.

story.idea: Alex and Bob are brothers cycling in a park. Bob wants to race, but Alex rides carefully. Alex notices a branch, slows down, and helps Bob understand why safety matters.
story.theme: Safety is more important than speed.
story.moral: Ride slowly, watch the path, and help each other.

generation_policy.consistent_character_note: VideoExpress works best with no more than two locked recurring characters.
generation_policy.dialogue_format: Quotation marks appear only around the exact sentence to be spoken. Voice and performance instructions are unquoted.
generation_policy.acceptance_policy: Accept the first successfully completed take unless VideoExpress reports an explicit failure.
